settings.population: parent HIGH only; all native child outcomes retained
settings.weighting: equal response totals; beta-proportional within each response
settings.geometry: joint categorical (e,r,n), where n is available followers
settings.scaling: parent-only weighted mean/SD, fixed across draws; zero SD uses scale 1

bootstrap.interval_scope: Percentiles of identified draws only; every unidentifiable or failed draw is retained, never replaced.

interpretation: Retrospective adjusted associations under one fixed historical native update; not effects of applying shared-credit allocation.
